purpose: Verify one Campaign065 mechanism against every frozen historical factor definition, retain the structurally nonnumeric Campaign063 challenge explicitly, and freeze the exact candidate before any Campaign065 value is opened.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_range_weak_order_time_reversal_divergence_236t
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A larger forward-versus-reverse divergence in local intraday volatility-state evolution may indicate unresolved directional information assimilation that remains relevant from the next open through the third close.
selected_mechanism.bar_grid: Exactly 120 high/low bars in 09:31--11:30 and exactly 120 in 13:01--15:00; exclude 09:30 and never cross lunch.
selected_mechanism.range_rule: For every selected bar require finite low>0 and finite high>=low, then x=ln(high/low). Exact high=low produces x=0 and is retained.
selected_mechanism.triple_rule: Within each half form every overlapping consecutive triple (x_i,x_{i+1},x_{i+2}) for i=0..117, giving exactly 118 morning and 118 afternoon triples and 236 pooled triples with equal weight.
selected_mechanism.weak_order_rule: Classify each triple by the exact zero-tolerance key (cmp(x0,x1),cmp(x0,x2),cmp(x1,x2)), with cmp in {-1,0,+1}; require one of the 13 transitive weak-order states and retain all ties.
selected_mechanism.time_reversal_rule: For every weak-order state s represented by (x0,x1,x2), define R(s) as the state of (x2,x1,x0). Let p_s be the observed pooled frequency and q_s=p_R(s). R is the exact fixed involution induced by triple reversal; no state pairing is learned or selected.
selected_mechanism.formula: Let m_s=(p_s+q_s)/2 over all 13 states. Score=[0.5*sum_{p_s>0} p_s*ln(p_s/m_s)+0.5*sum_{q_s>0} q_s*ln(q_s/m_s)]/ln(2).
selected_mechanism.zero_semantics: If the empirical state distribution is exactly invariant under reversal, including an all-tied path, score zero is valid. No pseudocount is required because each positive p_s or q_s has positive m_s.
selected_mechanism.missing_rule: Missing for an incomplete fixed grid, invalid/nonfinite high or low, high<low, nonfinite log range, an unrecognized/nontransitive state, a triple count other than 236, a nonfinite divergence, or a score outside [0,1] before 1e-12 endpoint canonicalization. Never fill, jitter, clip, winsorize, threshold, filter, or substitute.

overlap_challenges.reason: Campaign064 is the Shannon entropy H(p) of the forward 13-state distribution. Campaign065 is JSD(p,Rp), which is zero for any reversal-balanced distribution regardless of entropy and can be positive for distributions with equal or similar entropy. Reversing every range path preserves Campaign064 exactly and swaps p with Rp while preserving Campaign065; rebalancing each reversal pair can change Campaign065 without fixing H(p).

These mechanisms use signed or absolute close returns, Fourier power, moments, run structure, or variance aggregation. Campaign065 has no close or return magnitude and uses only reversal-pair imbalance in ordinal high-low range triples.

These factors retain range shares, price interval levels, overlap, frontier, midrange, close location, wick/body geometry, clock bins, or morning-afternoon alignment. Campaign065 is invariant to common strictly increasing range transforms and to price-level translations that preserve local range weak orders.
Campaign065 reads no amount or volume and contains no activity weight, participation profile, activity-price coupling, center of mass, or lead-lag statistic.

Transaction-price and VWAP mechanisms require amount/volume or close relative to a price anchor. Campaign065 has neither. Candidate49 remains future-only and is challenged without historical Candidate49 returns or ledger backfill.

These factors require synchronous peers, market moments, residuals, correlation, dispersion, or standardized return states. Campaign065 is a standalone stock-day high-low range sequence. Campaign063 remains an explicit nonnumeric mechanism challenge and is not silently treated as a pass or fail.
These factors align separate days, halves, or lunch endpoints. Campaign065 pools fixed local triples inside each half and creates no cross-day, cross-half, or lunch transition.

These price-path mechanisms use endpoint direction, close updates, drawdown, gaps, shocks, extrema timing, or price-level geometry. Campaign065 discards direction and levels after forming unsigned log ranges.
Campaign065 reads no accounting, announcement, peer disclosure, quarterly, or fundamental field.
Campaign065 is one source statistic and consumes no prior factor value, percentile consensus, fit, residual, model, or combination.

counterfactual_independence_tests: Holding all 240 high-low ranges fixed while changing admissible closes, open, volume, amount, peer populations, and quarterly records leaves Campaign065 unchanged.
Any common strictly increasing transform of the 240 range values preserves all weak-order states and Campaign065 while generally changing magnitude-, variance-, covariance-, and range-share factors.

Replacing p by any reversal-balanced distribution can change Campaign064 entropy while Campaign065 remains zero; moving mass within a reversal pair can make Campaign065 positive without uniquely determining entropy.
Reversing every within-half range path swaps p and q and leaves symmetric Jensen-Shannon divergence unchanged, whereas cubic signed-return time-arrow and endpoint-direction statistics may change.

Translating or reshaping price intervals while preserving the ordering of their log widths leaves Campaign065 unchanged but can change interval overlap, frontier, revisit, wick, body, and boundary factors.
Changing a cross-sectional peer return population while holding one stock's high-low path fixed changes Campaign063 and market-relative factors but leaves Campaign065 unchanged.
